# Accordion

Accordions collapse long content into scannable sections that expand on demand. Three sizes, a leading or trailing chevron, a flush variant with inset separators, and disabled items. Ported from the DGA library's nds-accordion component.

**Stylesheet:** `components/accordion/accordion.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/accordion.js` (classes `AccordionManager`). Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for configuring accordions, mapped from the library's nds-accordion API.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.accordion` | Base | — | List container (<ul>). Draws the bottom border of the last item. |
| `.accordion-item` | Base | — | One section: a header button plus a collapsible body, separated by top borders. |
| `.accordion-item--lg\|--md\|--sm` | Modifier | `size` | Header padding density: 16px / 12×16px / 8×16px. |
| `.accordion-item--icon-leading` | Modifier | `icon-alignment` | Moves the chevron before the title and indents the body under it. Default is trailing. |
| `.accordion-item--flush` | Modifier | `flush` | Replaces full-width borders with an inset separator that stops 16px from each edge. |
| `.accordion-item.active` | State | `is-open` | Expanded: the chevron rotates 180° and the body animates to its measured height. |
| `.accordion-item.disabled` | State | `disabled` | Grays the item out and ignores interaction. |
| .accordion-item__header / __title / __arrow / __body | Element | title, content | Header is a real <button> with aria-expanded; the title is 16px semibold, the body 16px regular. |

## Default

Trailing chevron, large density. Click any header to expand it; items operate independently.

```html
<ul class="accordion">
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">What is the digital services portal?</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body">
            <p>A unified portal for accessing government digital services in the Kingdom, built on the DGA
                design system.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">How do I create an account?</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body">
            <p>You can register with the national single sign-on in a few minutes.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">Is the service free?</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body">
            <p>Yes. All core services are available at no charge.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
</ul>
```

## Leading Icon

The chevron moves before the title and the expanded body indents under it.

```html
<ul class="accordion">
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg accordion-item--icon-leading">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="accordion-item__title">Leading chevron</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body">
            <p>The body aligns with the title, indented past the chevron column.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg accordion-item--icon-leading">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="accordion-item__title">Second section</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body"><p>More content.</p></div>
    </li>
</ul>
```

## Flush

Separators stop 16px short of each edge for use inside cards and panels.

```html
<ul class="accordion">
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg accordion-item--flush">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">First flush section</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body"><p>Body content.</p></div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg accordion-item--flush">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">Second flush section</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body"><p>Body content.</p></div>
    </li>
</ul>
```

## Disabled

Disabled items gray out and ignore hover, focus, and clicks.

```html
<ul class="accordion">
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg disabled">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false" disabled="">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">Disabled section</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body"><p>Not reachable.</p></div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">Enabled section</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body"><p>Works as usual.</p></div>
    </li>
</ul>
```

## RTL Layout

Header order and body indentation mirror in right-to-left layouts.

```html
<ul class="accordion">
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">ما هي بوابة الخدمات الرقمية؟</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body">
            <p>بوابة موحدة للوصول إلى الخدمات الحكومية الرقمية في المملكة.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
    <li class="accordion-item accordion-item--lg">
        <button type="button" class="accordion-item__header" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="accordion-item__title">كيف يمكنني إنشاء حساب؟</span>
            <span class="accordion-item__arrow icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-item__body">
            <p>يمكنك التسجيل باستخدام النفاذ الوطني الموحد خلال دقائق.</p>
        </div>
    </li>
</ul>
```
